doc.title: Fred Radke interviewed by Monk Rowe, Hillsdale, Michigan, November 8, 2023

title: Born too late; Joe Bushkin and Bunny Berigan
summary: Both feel born too late; Joe Bushkin told Radke so and praised Bunny Berigan.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Bix Beiderbecke: hearing, copying and remembering him

blocks.x: Sometimes I’ve felt like I was born too late.
Absolutely. Oh absolutely. You know who Joe Bushkin was?

Well Joe was my good friend and we played together — I did his last album. Joe and I belonged to an organization together that we spent time together. And Bushkin used to — he told me, he says, “Fred, you were born too late.” And of course Bushkin, you know who Bushkin’s best friend was Bunny Berigan. That was his buddy. He says, “I love Harry James, believe me,” he says, “but nobody played like Bunny. He was the best you know. And oh Bushkin was something else. But let me digress for a second about Corky Corcoran. Corky Corcoran was like from Tacoma and he was like 15 years old and he was a master player, and Jimmie Lunceford comes through town and he says, “You know I want to play with this band.” The piano player says, “Nobody sits in with this band. You know who these guys are?” I think Coleman Hawkins was on the band or something.
